text:
alex: @deploy-bot preflight flagged the migration 'add_user_flags_idx'. Holdpoint requested — exclusive lock estimate ~5m but there's a long-running query on users table. tagging @oncall-bot.

deploy-bot: preflight failed: blocking_pids=[2345,2370], reason=long_running_query (>10m), estimated_lock_time=300s. suggested_action=hold_deploy. logs:
```
ERROR: could not acquire lock on relation users
blocking query pid=2345: UPDATE users SET last_seen = now() WHERE ...
```

maria: ack. which process is that? can we nudge it or move to warm-failover? :eyes:

jen: pid 2345 is the realtime-eng-backfill job kicked off at 02:10. it's on tenant shard 7. we shouldn't kill without coord — might leave partial state. :warning:

tim: can we route migration to replica in read-only for index build and then promote? risky. warm-failover seems safer: run index concurrently on follower and swap. but we need a plan for KV cache and retries.

alex: i'd prefer avoiding manual kills. proposal: pause deploy, move to scheduled slot at 03:00 UTC (quiet window), or run an escape-hatch that uses concurrent index + online backfill. which do we want?

oncall-bot: current cluster load: 72% CPU, 3 long queries >10m (pids 2345, 2601, 2702). Next maintenance slot in 50m. windows_available=[03:00-03:30 UTC, 04:00-04:30 UTC].

maria: ok let's pause. alex please pin the release to 1.4.3-canary so no downstream rollout occurs. alex: can you also add a release note about delaying due to backfill lock?

alex: done — pinned version 1.4.3-canary. release note: "Migration add_user_flags_idx postponed due to blocking backfill; will retry during 03:00 UTC quiet window. No user-visible impact expected." @jen please confirm the backfill can be paused/resumed. :thumbsup:

jen: confirmed. i'll stage a safe pause at 02:55 and resume at 03:05. i'll post progress in this thread.

tim: if pause fails, fallback: abort migration and tag for manual re-run with safe-apply flag. keep logs.

alex: agree. leaving deploybot holdpoint in place. folks please react with :thumbsup: when you see this is ok.

jen: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: holdpoint set by alex at 1733333333. deploybot will retry preflight automatically at next attempt or when holdpoint cleared.

alex: I'll update the release notes and add the rollback decision to the ticket. will reopen thread once backfill paused.
